title: Characterization of the canonical support quotient map
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, j:U→P an open immersion of schemes, Q,I,J ordinary integer cochain complexes of A-module sheaves on the small etale site of P, Q termwise flat, a:Q⊗I→J and v:Q⊗j_*j^*I→j_*j^*J. Then IsRightMap j Q I J a v [def-pur-etale-kflat-support-data] holds if and only if v is heterogeneously equal to the canonical OpenSupport.rightMap of [lem-pur-flat-support-chain-diagram]. These arrows have definitionally equal endpoints, so this HEq is equality of arrows. No support-row map, replacement functor, injectivity or boundedness is required.

source.place: Tag 093X, lemma-restriction-along-monomorphism-surjective; actual support rows and their tensor/kernel comparison, as required by lem-pur-etale-kflat-support-comparison.

proof.text: The chain-diagram lemma gives precisely the stated summand composites of its canonical right map. A map from the total tensor is determined by the composites with the coproduct injection for every bidegree: apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext and mapBifunctor.hom_ext. Thus two maps satisfying IsRightMap are equal. Apply this uniqueness to m.τ₃ and the canonical map for the forward direction; substitute equality and use its summand formula for the reverse direction.
